In 'remote' mode nothing is loaded until this is\n    # called, and search() then returns no sessions at all, without raising.\n    One.load_cache(one, tables_dir=tables)\n    # Only the datalimit dataset ships this file; on the full dataset there is nothing to\n    # restrict to, and subset_csv stays None.\n    path = os.path.join(datadir, 'DATALIMIT_SUBSET.csv')\n    subset_csv = path if os.path.isfile(path) else None\n\n\n# --- sessions ---\n\ndef select_sessions():\n    \"\"\"Released sessions that have everything the decoder needs, grouped by subject.\"\"\"\n\n    required = ['spikes.times.npy', 'spikes.clusters.npy',          # ephys\n                '_ibl_trials.table.pqt',                            # task\n                '_ibl_wheel.position.npy', '_ibl_wheel.timestamps.npy']\n\n    keep = set(one.search(query_type='local', datasets=required))\n    keep &= (set(one.search(query_type='local', datasets=['leftCamera.ROIMotionEnergy.npy',\n                                                          '_ibl_leftCamera.times.npy']))\n             | set(one.search(query_type='local', datasets=['rightCamera.ROIMotionEnergy.npy',\n                                                            '_ibl_rightCamera.times.npy'])))\n    # The datalimit dataset ships a subset of the release (see DATALIMIT_SUBSET.csv). The ONE\n    # release index is unmodified and still lists every released session, so\n    # restrict to the eids named there -- otherwise a session that is not on disk\n    # would be fetched over the network. The full dataset has no such file, and every\n    # session the index lists is on disk.\n    # Compare in string space: one.search returns UUID objects while the csv column\n    # is str, so a plain set intersection is empty whatever the contents. keep must\n    # stay UUID-valued for the `eid in keep` test below.\n    if subset_csv is not None:\n        subset_eids = set(pd.read_csv(subset_csv).eid.astype(str))\n        keep = {eid for eid in keep if str(eid) in subset_eids}\n        if not keep:\n            raise SystemExit(f'No sessions matched {subset_csv}; refusing to continue.')\n\n    eids, info = one.search(query_type='local', details=True)\n    selected = {}\n    for eid, session in zip(eids, info):\n        if eid in keep:\n            selected.setdefault(session['subject'], []).append(str(eid))\n    return {subject: selected[subject] for subject in sorted(selected)}\n\n\ndef camera_view(eid):\n    \"\"\"The side camera this session has whisker motion energy for, left preferred.\"\"\"\n    for view in ('left', 'right'):\n        if len(one.list_datasets(eid, filename=f'{view}Camera.ROIMotionEnergy.npy',\n                                 query_type='local')):\n            return view\n    raise ValueError(f'no whisker motion energy for {eid}')\n\n\n# --- trials ---\n\ndef trial_variables(trials):\n    \"\"\"Choice, block prior and trial number in block, one row per trial.\"\"\"\n    # probabilityLeft is constant within a block, so a change of value starts a new block\n    block = (trials.probabilityLeft != trials.probabilityLeft.shift()).cumsum()\n\n    return pd.DataFrame({'choice': trials.choice.map(CHOICE),\n                         'prior': trials.probabilityLeft.map(PRIOR),\n                         'trial_in_block': trials.groupby(block).cumcount()})\n\n\ndef covered(times, stim_on):\n    \"\"\"Trials whose window is spanned by this stream, allowing the one bin gap the reference allows.\"\"\"\n    start, stop = stim_on + T_START, stim_on + T_STOP\n    begin = np.searchsorted(times, start, side='right')      # first sample inside the window\n    end = np.searchsorted(times, stop, side='left') - 1       # last sample inside the window\n\n    # a trial with no sample at all, or a gap at either edge, has no usable trace\n    inside = begin <= end\n    first = np.where(inside, times[np.clip(begin, 0, times.size - 1)], np.inf)\n    last = np.where(inside, times[np.clip(end, 0, times.size - 1)], -np.inf)\n    return inside & (np.abs(start - first) <= BIN) & (np.abs(stop - last) <= BIN)\n\n\ndef usable_trials(trials, wheel_times, camera_times):\n    \"\"\"Trials the paper would keep, that also have a full wheel and camera window.\"\"\"\n    stim_on = trials.stimOn_times.to_numpy()\n    reaction = trials.firstMovement_times.to_numpy() - stim_on\n\n    keep = (reaction >= MIN_RT) & (reaction <= MAX_RT)          # NaN compares false, so those go too\n    keep &= trials.choice.isin(CHOICE).to_numpy()               # drops the no response trials\n    keep &= trials.probabilityLeft.isin(PRIOR).to_numpy()\n\n    return keep & covered(wheel_times, stim_on) & covered(camera_times, stim_on)\n\n\n# --- behavior ---\n\ndef window_slice(times, stim_on):\n    \"\"\"Index range of each trial window, so a stream is sliced rather than rescanned per trial.\"\"\"\n    window_start = stim_on + T_START\n    window_stop = stim_on + T_STOP\n\n    # the samples are in time order, so each window is one contiguous range of them\n    begin = np.searchsorted(times, window_start)\n    end = np.searchsorted(times, window_stop)\n\n    return begin, end\n\n\ndef trial_traces(times, values, stim_on):\n    \"\"\"A continuous trace resampled onto the same time grid for every trial.\"\"\"\n    begin, end = window_slice(times, stim_on)\n\n    traces = []\n    for trial, onset in enumerate(stim_on):\n        # one sample either side of the window, so the first and last bin centre are\n        # interpolated rather than clamped to the nearest sample inside it\n        first = max(begin[trial] - 1, 0)\n        last = end[trial] + 1\n\n        traces.append(np.interp(onset + TIME, times[first:last], values[first:last]))\n\n    return np.array(traces)\n\n\ndef discretize(trace):\n    \"\"\"Equal sized classes, split at percentiles of this session's own trace.\"\"\"\n    return np.digitize(trace, np.percentile(trace, SPLIT))\n\n\n# --- neural ---\n\ndef load_neural(eid):\n    \"\"\"Spike times and good clusters of a session, merged over its probes.\"\"\"\n    times, units, regions = [], [], []\n    for pid, name in zip(*one.eid2pid(eid)):\n        loader = SpikeSortingLoader(pid=pid, one=one, eid=eid, pname=name)\n\n        # skip the md5 check, which rereads every spike file and draws its own progress bar\n        spikes, clusters, channels = loader.load_spike_sorting(check_hash=False)\n\n        # a session can hold an insertion whose spike sorting was never released\n        if not clusters:\n            continue\n\n        clusters = loader.merge_clusters(spikes, clusters, channels)   # attaches metrics and histology\n\n        # `void` is the atlas label for a channel the histology placed outside the brain,\n        # so a unit there is not in a brain region at all\n        in_brain = brain_regions.acronym2acronym(\n            clusters['acronym'], mapping='Beryl') != 'void'\n\n        # spikes.clusters holds the row of the cluster table, so a per cluster flag\n        # can be indexed by it directly to say whether each spike survives\n        is_good = (clusters['label'] >= QC_LABEL) & in_brain\n        keep = is_good[spikes['clusters']]\n\n        # renumber the surviving clusters, continuing the count from the previous probe\n        new_index = np.cumsum(is_good) - 1\n        units.append(new_index[spikes['clusters'][keep]] + len(regions))\n        times.append(spikes['times'][keep])\n\n        # Beryl is the coarser atlas the reference code uses, e.g. DG-sg and DG-mo both become DG\n        regions.extend(brain_regions.acronym2acronym(clusters['acronym'][is_good], mapping='Beryl'))\n\n    times, units = np.concatenate(times), np.concatenate(units)\n\n    # sort the merged probes by spike time, as the reference does, so trials can be sliced\n    order = np.argsort(times, kind='stable')\n    return times[order], units[order], np.array(regions)\n\n\ndef spike_counts(times, units, n_units, stim_on):\n    \"\"\"Spike count per unit and bin, for every trial.\"\"\"\n    counts = np.empty((stim_on.size, n_units, N_BINS))\n    begin, end = window_slice(times, stim_on)\n\n    for trial, onset in enumerate(stim_on):\n        spike_time = times[begin[trial]:end[trial]] - onset      # time from stimulus onset\n        spike_unit = units[begin[trial]:end[trial]]\n\n        bin_index = np.floor((spike_time - T_START) / BIN).astype(np.int64)\n        \n        # a spike sitting on the window edge can round out of range once the onset is subtracted\n        bin_index = np.clip(bin_index, 0, N_BINS - 1)\n\n        # one flat index per spike lets a single bincount fill the whole unit by bin grid\n        flat_index = spike_unit * N_BINS + bin_index\n        counts[trial] = np.bincount(flat_index, minlength=n_units * N_BINS).reshape(n_units, N_BINS)\n\n    return counts\n\n\n# --- session ---\n\ndef process_session(eid, subject):\n    \"\"\"One session as lists of per trial neural, input and output arrays.\"\"\"\n    loader = SessionLoader(one=one, eid=eid)\n    loader.load_trials()\n    loader.load_wheel()\n    view = camera_view(eid)\n    loader.load_motion_energy(views=[view])\n\n    trials, wheel = loader.trials, loader.wheel\n    motion_energy = loader.motion_energy[f'{view}Camera']\n\n    variables = trial_variables(trials)                 # before filtering, so the block count is real\n    keep = usable_trials(trials, wheel.times.to_numpy(), motion_energy.times.to_numpy())\n    variables = variables[keep]\n    stim_on = trials.stimOn_times.to_numpy()[keep]\n\n    # no trial survived the mask, so there is nothing to load or bin\n    if stim_on.size == 0:\n        return {'session_id': str(eid), 'subject': subject, 'camera': view,\n                'neural': [], 'input': [], 'output': [],\n                'n_trials': 0, 'n_units': 0, 'regions': np.array([])}\n\n    speed = trial_traces(wheel.times, np.abs(wheel.velocity), stim_on)\n    whisker = trial_traces(motion_energy.times, motion_energy.iloc[:, 1], stim_on)\n\n    spike_times, spike_units, regions = load_neural(eid)\n    rate = spike_counts(spike_times, spike_units, regions.size, stim_on) / BIN\n\n\"\"\"Convert the IBL Brain-Wide Map dataset to the decoder-ready pickle format.\n\nData are read exclusively through the ONE API (`one.api.ONE`) with the brainbox loaders\n(`SessionLoader`, `SpikeSortingLoader`), in `mode='remote'`, which resolves dataset revisions\nfrom the REST responses cached in the staged ONE cache.\n\nProcessing follows the reference pipeline of Zhang et al. (`/app/code/code_zhang2025`,\n`src/0_data_caching.py` + `src/utils/ibl_data_utils.py`) and the inclusion criteria of the IBL\nBrain-Wide Map paper:\n\n  * trials aligned to `stimOn_times`, window (-0.5, +1.5) s, 20 ms bins  -> T = 100\n  * probes of a session merged into one population\n  * only well-isolated units (IBL unit QC `label == 1`) in grey matter (Beryl region not void/root)\n  * trials filtered with the reference `load_trials_and_mask` criteria\n  * wheel speed = |wheel velocity|, whisker motion energy from the left camera (right as fallback),\n    linearly interpolated onto the trial bin grid exactly as `get_behavior_per_interval` does\n\nUsage:\n    python -u /app/convert_data.py <outpicklefile> [--full | --sample] [--show-processing]\n\"\"\"\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport pickle\nimport time\nimport traceback\nimport multiprocessing as mp\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Parameters -- identical to the reference `params` in src/0_data_caching.py\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------\nALIGN_TIME = 'stimOn_times'\nTIME_WINDOW = (-0.5, 1.5)          # seconds relative to the alignment event\nBINSIZE = 0.02                     # seconds\nNBINS = int(np.ceil((TIME_WINDOW[1] - TIME_WINDOW[0]) / BINSIZE))   # 100\n\nMIN_RT, MAX_RT = 0.08, 2.0         # reference load_trials_and_mask defaults\nMAX_TRIAL_LEN = 10.0               # reference prepare_data passes max_trial_len=10.0\nNAN_EXCLUDE = ['stimOn_times', 'choice', 'feedback_times',\n               'probabilityLeft', 'firstMovement_times', 'feedbackType']\n\nQC_LABEL = 1.0                     # IBL unit QC: 1 == passes all three RIGOR single-unit metrics\nEXCLUDE_REGIONS = ('void', 'root')  # not grey matter / outside the brain\nMIN_NEURONS = 5      # BWM paper: analyses require >= 5 well-isolated neurons\nMIN_TRIALS = 2\n\nBWM_RELEASE_CSV = '/app/code/code_zhang2025/data/bwm_release.csv'\nONE_BASE_URL = 'https://openalyx.internationalbrainlab.org'\n\nINPUT_NAMES = ['time_from_stim_on', 'trial_number_in_block']\nOUTPUT_NAMES = ['choice', 'prior_prob_left', 'wheel_speed', 'whisker_motion_energy']\nOUTPUT_VALUES = [\n    ['left', 'right'],\n    ['0.2', '0.5', '0.8'],\n    ['low', 'medium', 'high'],\n    ['low', 'medium', 'high'],\n]\n\n\ndef get_one():\n    \"\"\"ONE instance backed by the staged local cache (works fully offline).\"\"\"\n    from one.api import ONE\n    return ONE(base_url=ONE_BASE_URL, mode='remote')\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Trial curation -- copy of reference `load_trials_and_mask` query (ibl_data_utils.py)\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef compute_trials_mask(trials, min_rt=MIN_RT, max_rt=MAX_RT, max_trial_len=MAX_TRIAL_LEN,\n                        nan_exclude=NAN_EXCLUDE, exclude_nochoice=True):\n    query = f'(firstMovement_times - stimOn_times < {min_rt})'\n    query += f' | (firstMovement_times - stimOn_times > {max_rt})'\n    if max_trial_len is not None:\n        query += f' | (feedback_times - goCue_times > {max_trial_len})'\n    for event in nan_exclude:\n        query += f' | {event}.isnull()'\n    if exclude_nochoice:\n        query += ' | (choice == 0)'\n    return ~trials.eval(query)\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Neural binning -- equivalent to reference bin_spiking_data / bincount2D\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef bin_spikes(spike_times, spike_clusters, n_clusters, align_times,\n               t_start=TIME_WINDOW[0], t_end=TIME_WINDOW[1], binsize=BINSIZE, n_bins=NBINS):\n    \"\"\"Spike counts in (n_trials, n_clusters, n_bins).\n\n    Bin j of a trial covers [align + t_start + j*binsize, align + t_start + (j+1)*binsize),\n    the same half-open convention as `iblutil.numerical.bincount2D(xlim=[t_beg, t_end])`.\n    `spike_clusters` must already be re-indexed to 0..n_clusters-1.\n    \"\"\"\n    n_trials = len(align_times)\n    out = np.zeros((n_trials, n_clusters, n_bins), dtype=np.float32)\n    begs = align_times + t_start\n    ends = align_times + t_end\n    i0 = np.searchsorted(spike_times, begs, side='left')\n    i1 = np.searchsorted(spike_times, ends, side='left')\n    for k in range(n_trials):\n        s, e = i0[k], i1[k]\n        if e <= s:\n            continue\n        b = ((spike_times[s:e] - begs[k]) / binsize).astype(np.int64)\n        np.clip(b, 0, n_bins - 1, out=b)\n        idx = spike_clusters[s:e].astype(np.int64) * n_bins + b\n        cnt = np.bincount(idx, minlength=n_clusters * n_bins)\n        out[k] = cnt.reshape(n_clusters, n_bins)\n    return out\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Behaviour binning -- equivalent to reference get_behavior_per_interval\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef bin_behavior(times, values, align_times, t_start=TIME_WINDOW[0], t_end=TIME_WINDOW[1],\n                 binsize=BINSIZE, n_bins=NBINS):\n    \"\"\"Interpolate a continuous behavioural signal onto the trial bin grid.\n\n    Returns (n_trials, n_bins) array and a boolean validity mask.  As in the reference, the\n    interpolation grid is `np.linspace(beg + binsize, end, n_bins)` (the right edge of every bin)\n    and a trial is invalid if the signal does not cover the window (starts too late / ends too\n    early, by more than one bin) or contains NaNs inside the window.\n    \"\"\"\n    begs = align_times + t_start\n    ends = align_times + t_end\n    n_trials = len(align_times)\n    out = np.zeros((n_trials, n_bins), dtype=np.float64)\n    valid = np.ones(n_trials, dtype=bool)\n\n    idx_beg = np.searchsorted(times, begs, side='right')\n    idx_end = np.searchsorted(times, ends, side='left')\n\n    grid = (np.linspace(binsize, t_end - t_start, n_bins)[None, :] + begs[:, None])\n    for k in range(n_trials):\n        ib, ie = idx_beg[k], idx_end[k]\n        if ie <= ib:\n            valid[k] = False\n            continue\n        tt = times[ib:ie]\n        vv = values[ib:ie]\n        if np.abs(begs[k] - tt[0]) > binsize or np.abs(ends[k] - tt[-1]) > binsize:\n            valid[k] = False      # target data starts too late / ends too early\n            continue\n        if np.any(np.isnan(vv)):\n            valid[k] = False      # NaNs would break the decoder\n            continue\n        out[k] = np.interp(grid[k], tt, vv)\n    return out, valid\n\n\ndef discretize_tertiles(x, valid_rows):\n    \"\"\"Discretize a (n_trials, n_bins) signal into 3 classes using per-session tertiles.\"\"\"\n    ref = x[valid_rows].ravel()\n    q1, q2 = np.quantile(ref, [1. / 3., 2. / 3.])\n    lab = np.zeros(x.shape, dtype=np.int64)\n    lab[x > q1] = 1\n    lab[x > q2] = 2\n    return lab, (float(q1), float(q2))\n\n\ndef trial_number_in_block(prob_left):\n    \"\"\"0-based index of each trial within its block, computed on the raw trial sequence.\"\"\"\n    pl = np.asarray(prob_left, dtype=float)\n    newblock = np.ones(len(pl), dtype=bool)\n    newblock[1:] = pl[1:] != pl[:-1]\n    idx = np.zeros(len(pl), dtype=np.int64)\n    c = 0\n    for i in range(len(pl)):\n        c = 0 if newblock[i] else c + 1\n        idx[i] = c\n    return idx\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Per-session conversion\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef convert_session(eid, show_processing=False, outdir='/app'):\n    \"\"\"Convert one session; returns a dict or None if the session is unusable.\"\"\"\n    from brainbox.io.one import SessionLoader, SpikeSortingLoader\n    from iblatlas.regions import BrainRegions\n\n    t_start_session = time.time()\n    timing = {}\n    one = get_one()\n    br = BrainRegions()\n\n    # ---------------- trials ----------------\n    t0 = time.time()\n    sl = SessionLoader(one=one, eid=eid)\n    sl.load_trials()\n    trials = sl.trials\n    mask = compute_trials_mask(trials).to_numpy()\n    timing['trials'] = time.time() - t0\n    if mask.sum() < MIN_TRIALS:\n        return dict(eid=eid, skipped='too few trials after mask')\n\n    # ---------------- spikes ----------------\n    t0 = time.time()\n    pids, pnames = one.eid2pid(eid)\n    spike_times_l, spike_clu_l, acronyms_l, labels_l = [], [], [], []\n    probe_t0, probe_t1 = [], []          # spike-sorted recording coverage per probe\n    offset = 0\n    for pid, pname in zip(pids, pnames):\n        ssl = SpikeSortingLoader(pid=str(pid), one=one, eid=eid, pname=pname)\n        spikes, clusters, channels = ssl.load_spike_sorting()\n        clu = SpikeSortingLoader.merge_clusters(spikes, clusters, channels).to_df()\n        # merge probes as in reference `merge_probes`: offset cluster ids so they stay unique\n        probe_t0.append(np.nanmin(spikes['times']))\n        probe_t1.append(np.nanmax(spikes['times']))\n        spike_times_l.append(spikes['times'])\n        spike_clu_l.append(spikes['clusters'] + offset)\n        acronyms_l.append(clu['acronym'].to_numpy())\n        labels_l.append(clu['label'].to_numpy())\n        offset += int(clu.index.max()) + 1\n    spike_times = np.concatenate(spike_times_l)\n    spike_clusters = np.concatenate(spike_clu_l)\n    acronyms = np.concatenate(acronyms_l)\n    labels = np.concatenate(labels_l)\n    srt = np.argsort(spike_times, kind='stable')\n    spike_times = spike_times[srt]\n    spike_clusters = spike_clusters[srt]\n    timing['spikes'] = time.time() - t0\n\n    # ---------------- neuron curation ----------------\n    beryl = br.acronym2acronym(acronyms, mapping='Beryl')\n    keep = (labels >= QC_LABEL) & (~np.isin(beryl, EXCLUDE_REGIONS))\n    keep_ids = np.where(keep)[0]\n    if len(keep_ids) < MIN_NEURONS:\n        return dict(eid=eid, skipped='too few good neurons')\n    remap = -np.ones(offset, dtype=np.int64)\n    remap[keep_ids] = np.arange(len(keep_ids))\n    sel = np.isin(spike_clusters, keep_ids)\n    sp_t = spike_times[sel]\n    sp_c = remap[spike_clusters[sel]]\n    regions = beryl[keep_ids]\n\n    # ---------------- behaviour ----------------\n    t0 = time.time()\n    sl.load_wheel()\n    wheel_times = sl.wheel['times'].to_numpy()\n    wheel_speed_raw = np.abs(sl.wheel['velocity'].to_numpy())\n\n    me_times = me_vals = None\n    camera_used = None\n    for view, key in (('left', 'leftCamera'), ('right', 'rightCamera')):\n        try:\n            sl.load_motion_energy(views=[view])\n            df = sl.motion_energy[key]\n            me_times = df['times'].to_numpy()\n            me_vals = df['whiskerMotionEnergy'].to_numpy()\n            camera_used = view\n            break\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n    if me_times is None:\n        return dict(eid=eid, skipped='no whisker motion energy')\n    timing['behavior_load'] = time.time() - t0\n\n    # ---------------- bin everything on the masked trials ----------------\n    t0 = time.time()\n    align_all = trials[ALIGN_TIME].to_numpy()\n    tnb_all = trial_number_in_block(trials['probabilityLeft'].to_numpy())\n    # A trial is only usable if its whole 2 s window is inside the spike-sorted recording of\n    # every probe: in a few sessions the ephys recording stops before the behaviour does, which\n    # would otherwise produce trials with no spikes at all.\n    rec_t0, rec_t1 = max(probe_t0), min(probe_t1)\n    covered = (align_all + TIME_WINDOW[0] >= rec_t0) & (align_all + TIME_WINDOW[1] <= rec_t1)\n    mask = mask & covered\n    if mask.sum() < MIN_TRIALS:\n        return dict(eid=eid, skipped='too few trials inside the ephys recording')\n    idx_trials = np.where(mask)[0]\n    align = align_all[idx_trials]\n\n    wheel_binned, wheel_valid = bin_behavior(wheel_times, wheel_speed_raw, align)\n    me_binned, me_valid = bin_behavior(me_times, me_vals, align)\n    good = wheel_valid & me_valid\n    if good.sum() < MIN_TRIALS:\n        return dict(eid=eid, skipped='too few trials with behaviour coverage')\n    idx_trials = idx_trials[good]\n    align = align[good]\n    wheel_binned = wheel_binned[good]\n    me_binned = me_binned[good]\n    timing['behavior_bin'] = time.time() - t0\n\n    t0 = time.time()\n    binned_spikes = bin_spikes(sp_t, sp_c, len(keep_ids), align)\n    timing['spike_bin'] = time.time() - t0\n\n    # Drop trials in which not a single neuron fired anywhere in the 2 s window: they carry no\n    # neural information (they occur in a few low-yield sessions and in silent stretches of a\n    # recording) and the decoder flags them as degenerate.\n    nonzero = binned_spikes.sum(axis=(1, 2)) > 0\n    if nonzero.sum() < MIN_TRIALS:\n        return dict(eid=eid, skipped='too few trials with any spikes')\n    if not np.all(nonzero):\n        binned_spikes = binned_spikes[nonzero]\n        idx_trials = idx_trials[nonzero]\n        align = align[nonzero]\n        wheel_binned = wheel_binned[nonzero]\n        me_binned = me_binned[nonzero]\n\n    #
